why: Each item is taken once or not at all under a weight limit, maximising value: this is 0/1 knapsack exactly, with weights[i] as weight, values[i] as value and capacity as the limit.
hints: Each item is a yes/no decision with a weight cost. What table lets you combine decisions without trying all 2^n subsets?
dp[c] = best value with total weight at most c using the items seen so far; for item (w, v): dp[c] = max(dp[c], dp[c - w] + v).
Iterate c from capacity down to w so each item is used once. O(n * capacity) time, O(capacity) space.
pitfalls: Looping capacity upward reuses an item (that is unbounded knapsack).
Capacity 0 or no items fits returns 0.
Zero-value items are harmless; do not special-case them wrongly.
